exposure: compound heterozygosity Glu242Lys and Leu252Val in the lipoprotein lipase (LPL) gene
cohort: A Chinese patient with a novel compound heterozygote of Glu242Lys and Leu252Val in the lipoprotein lipase gene.
finding: A novel compound heterozygote (Glu242Lys and Leu252Val) in the LPL gene was associated with LPL deficiency and defective LPL function, leading to recurrent hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis, particularly triggered by pregnancy.
